name: Old Town
summary: In Old Town, soldiers train beside weathered tenements and crowded alleys. The quarter largely survived the First War and remains home to Stormwind’s military Command Center and the covert headquarters of SI:7.

sections.title: A Relic of the Old Kingdom
sections.body: Old Town keeps much of the shape of Stormwind before the First War. While the Stonemasons rebuilt the rest of the city from the ground up, this quarter escaped total ruin. It never gained the pristine marble facades and grand canals found in the Trade District and Cathedral Square. Working folk, laborers, and the city’s poorest residents live among its crowded tenements. Its cobbled streets are narrower, dirtier, and more chaotic than those elsewhere in the capital, preserving the feel of the old kingdom.

sections.title: Soldiers, Spies, and Taverns
sections.body: Old Town holds Stormwind’s military officers, barracks, and combat trainers in the Command Center. Nearby, the Champions’ Hall gathers the Alliance’s finest warriors. At the district’s edge, SI:7 keeps its covert compound under the leadership of Master Mathias Shaw. Off-duty footmen and shadowy operatives meet at the Pig and Whistle Tavern, one of the city’s liveliest watering holes.

faq.q: Why does Old Town look so much dirtier than the rest of Stormwind?
aliases: why is old town run down
faq.answer: Old Town largely survived the Horde’s razing of Stormwind during the First War. The Stonemasons did not rebuild it from scratch, so it missed the pristine new masonry and grand architecture found elsewhere in the city.

faq.q: What is SI:7 and where is it located?
faq.answer: SI:7 is Stormwind and the Alliance’s secretive intelligence agency, overseen by Master Mathias Shaw. Its covert headquarters lies in the back of Old Town, past the training yards and military stables.

faq.q: What is the Command Center in Old Town used for?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s Command Center is the primary garrison and headquarters for its military. Officers coordinate the city’s defenses there, while warriors and hunters train alongside stable masters and riding instructors.

faq.q: Where is the tavern in Old Town?
faq.answer: The Pig and Whistle Tavern sits near the center of Old Town. Hungry soldiers, adventurers, and travelers gather there, and it is known for hearty cooking recipes.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find SI:7’s headquarters behind Old Town’s ordinary alleys, where master spies and covert handlers offer guidance.
As a warrior, you can seek combat training and gear at the Command Center and Champions’ Hall, where battle-tested veterans gather.
